intro.title: Other Pyramids
intro.descriptionHtml: Collection of different Pyramids, which are effective in unique ways. The Pyramid structure possesses intense positive, healing energies and charges the place it is kept in. The Pyramids like, the Wish Pyramid is for fulfilling wishes. Simply write your wishes in a piece of paper and keep it in the tomb with trust and positivity. Also, the Energy Pyramid is excellent for charging Rudraksha beads/Malas, Yantras by keeping them inside it for some time. These Pyramids can also be thoughtful gifts for friends and family.
